description: Cross-call themes planted across several transcripts. A theme counts as found if any theme item the model returns (theme + description + evidence text) satisfies the matcher: every inner list is a group, at least one regex in each group must match (case-insensitive).

themes.text: The ClearPay payment portal (migrated late February) auto-charges copays that were already paid at the front desk, causing duplicate charges; it recurs across billing, imaging, eye-surgery and complaint calls and has escalated as far as a collections referral.

Pre-procedure fasting instructions conflict: the mailed packet says nothing to eat or drink after midnight while the automated text reminder says clear liquids are allowed until 2 hours before arrival; this caused at least two same-day cancellations and repeated patient confusion.
